title: WorkflowDetail
description: Detailed representation of an Alteryx workflow including versions

runCount.description: Total number of times the workflow has been executed

districtTags.description: District tags assigned to the workflow

isPublic.description: Whether the workflow is publicly accessible

isReadyForMigration.description: Whether the workflow is ready for migration

publishedVersionId.description: ID of the currently published version

othersMayDownload.description: Whether other users may download the workflow

othersCanViewHistory.description: Whether other users can view execution history

othersCanExecute.description: Whether other users can execute the workflow

hasPrivateDataExemption.description: Whether the workflow has a private data exemption
